text: On 14/06/2026 at approximately 2130 hrs, a police patrol team on routine checking near Dongri stopped a motorcycle bearing registration number MH02 AB 1234 on suspicion. The rider was identified as Amit Sharma, resident of Dongri, Mumbai, age 27. On search, a package containing suspected narcotic substance weighing approximately 850 grams was recovered from the vehicle's side compartment. Amit Sharma was taken into custody under the NDPS Act. During preliminary interrogation, Amit Sharma stated that the consignment was handed to him by a person known as 'Suresh' near Andheri West, who he identified as his regular supplier, contactable on a number ending in 3455. Amit further stated that payments for previous consignments were made by depositing cash into an account in the name of 'P. Nair', which he believed to be handled on behalf of a senior figure referred to only as 'Sir' or sometimes 'RV'. Amit's own mobile number is 9930112233. Investigation is underway to trace the supply chain and identify 'RV'.

Complainant Neha Kapoor, shop owner in Chandni Chowk, Delhi, reported that she has been receiving threatening calls demanding protection money of Rs. 2,00,000, failing which her shop would be vandalized. The complainant identified the caller's voice as belonging to Vikram Singh, a known local figure operating in the Chandni Chowk-Karol Bagh belt. A sedan bearing registration DL8C XY 5678 was seen parked outside the complainant's shop on three separate occasions, and shopkeeper Sunita Devi corroborated seeing a man matching the description of Karan Mehta, believed to be Vikram Singh's associate, seated in the said vehicle. The complainant was instructed to deposit the demanded amount into an account registered under 'Gupta Traders', account number ending 9012, held with State Bank of India, Karol Bagh branch. Vikram Singh's number is on record as 9871122334. Further investigation is required to identify the beneficial owner behind Gupta Traders.

On 25/06/2026, a 10-wheeler truck bearing registration PB10 CZ 4321 was intercepted at the Amritsar checkpoint on a routine inspection. The driver was identified as Bhupinder Singh alias Bhupi, resident of Amritsar. A search of the vehicle revealed concealed packages consistent with narcotic transport. Bhupinder Singh's mobile phone, number 9814455667, was seized and preliminary call log analysis showed frequent contact with a number ending 9887, which was not saved under any name in the handset but was flagged as 'Mumbai contact' in Bhupinder's notes. Bhupinder also stated he had prior dealings with a man named Ali Khan of Amritsar who facilitates cross-border logistics contacts, phone number 9878123456. Further forensic analysis of the seized handset and call records has been requested to establish the identity of the Mumbai contact.

A preliminary enquiry was initiated based on information received from an informant, Meena Kumari, resident of Park Street area, Kolkata. The informant stated that a group operating under the name 'Farhan Sheikh' (phone number 9830011223) has been involved in suspicious recruitment activity in the Park Street locality, targeting vulnerable individuals with promises of employment outside the state. The informant further stated that during a conversation overheard at a local tea stall, Farhan Sheikh mentioned that funding and instructions for the operation come from someone referred to only as 'RV', described as based in Mumbai and known to be involved in 'other businesses' as well. No further details on 'RV' were available at this stage. This enquiry is being escalated to the state Anti-Human Trafficking Unit for coordination with other ongoing investigations.
